verdict.rationale:
Hatchet is fundamentally a background task/workflow orchestration engine with cron triggers, scheduled runs, durable retries, concurrency control, and explicit support for orchestrating AI agents autonomously (docs-16, docs-26, docs-27, docs-25, docs-11, gh-2, gh-3), and community evidence confirms real production use as a background job/workflow runner replacing Celery. Cookbooks show integration with Claude/OpenAI Agents SDKs for agentic workflows (hatchet-docs-34/36/37).

missing for 10: no independent hands-on account of a fully autonomous multi-day agent running unattended, and some community reports note scaling/reliability caveats under heavy load (hatchet-comm-11) rather than confirming flawless long-running autonomy.
